Position Overview
Details of the Division and Team:
Investment Bank: Fixed Income & Currencies
Fixed Income & Currencies brings together a top-ranked institutional sales force, world-class research with trading and structuring expertise across Foreign Exchange, Rates, Credit and Emerging Markets. The Fixed Income & Currencies business enables Deutsche Bank to respond to increasing automation, regulatory expectations and client demand for standardisation and transparency in execution across fixed income, currency and emerging markets.
Investment Bank: Investment Banking & Capital Markets
Investment Banking & Capital Markets aims to build long-term, trusted and mutually beneficial relationships with the major corporates, financial institutions, financial sponsors and sovereigns around the world. Our businesses cover Investment Banking Coverage, Debt Capital Markets (DCM), Equity Capital Markets (ECM), Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) etc.
Your Key Responsibilities And Required Skills
Looking for candidates with strong interest in Investment Bank – Fixed Income & Currencies (FIC) or Investment Banking & Capital Markets (IBCM). Ideal candidate should be a fast learner, attending to details, good with numbers.
Require candidates to be able to communicate well with the team, able to commit to work in terms of full attendance as agreed, and able to stay focused
Our interns are given the opportunity to learn about our business from different viewpoints, giving you a career advantage.
FIC:
Offer great exposure to how sales and trading work during market movements, with open environment that encourages discussions
Daily tasks involve data collection/maintenance of trading activities, market movements, DB’s pitch books/marketing materials
Assist team members in ad-hoc projects, fact finding, market research, documentation, KYC related task etc.
Administrative work including record keeping, data mining/analysis, liaise with back office when needed
IBCM:
Working on our day-to-day business as well as on special projects, you will contribute to the innovation of new ideas to help our customers achieve their financial goals
You will gain experience in different areas of our business and discover our market-leading solutions firsthand
Tasks may include credit research, preparing industry and market analyses for pitches, or getting involved in the execution of live deals
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Sr. Associate Director, Technology Management

Business:
CIB Technology
Principal Responsibilities
Regional incident management
Lead the coordination and management of major and high-priority incidents during time-zone coverage.
Act as the regional point of contact for incident response, ensuring timely engagement of technical teams, service owners, business stakeholders and leadership.
Establish clear incident command, ownership, communications and escalation paths.
Ensure incidents are assessed, prioritized, progressed and resolved in line with agreed service management processes and service-level expectations.
Coordinate effective handovers between other global operating regions.
Provide concise, timely and accurate updates to stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
Support post-incident reviews, ensuring root-cause analysis, lessons learned and remedial actions are completed.
Identify recurring issues and trends, and work with relevant teams to reduce repeat incidents and improve service resilience.
Change assurance
Lead or support change assurance activities across department.
Review planned changes for risk, impact, implementation readiness, testing, rollback arrangements and stakeholder communication.
Work with Change Advisory Boards, Change owners and technical teams to ensure changes meet required governance standards.
Monitor change outcomes, including failed, unauthorized or emergency changes, and drive corrective actions where required.
Promote a balanced approach that enables delivery while protecting service stability, regulatory obligations and customer outcomes.
ITSM practices
Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ITSM processes, standards and controls.
Ensure service management activities are appropriately documented, evidenced and aligned with internal risk and compliance requirements.
Maintain effective governance over incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, service level and configuration management practices, as applicable.
Prepare management information, risk reporting and service performance insights for regional and global stakeholders.
Track control actions, audit findings, process exceptions and remediation activities through to closure.
Partner with Risk, Compliance, Audit, Technology Control and service management teams to support reviews and regulatory commitments.
Contribute to operational resilience, service continuity and control improvement initiatives.
Global stakeholder and team coordination
Build strong working relationships with technology teams, service owners, business representatives and leadership across regions.
Coordinate activities across geographically distributed teams, encouraging consistent processes and clear accountability.
Represent the region in global ITSM forums, governance meetings and service reviews.
Facilitate communication between operational teams and senior stakeholders, translating technical issues into clear business impact and actions.
Encourage knowledge sharing and consistent adoption of ITSM standards across regions.
Requirements
Significant experience in IT service management, service operations or technology risk and control environments.
Proven experience leading major incident management in a complex, enterprise or regulated organisation.
Practical experience with change management, change assurance and ITSM governance.
Strong understanding of ITIL principles and service management best practice; ITIL certification is desirable.
Experience working with global, virtual and cross-functional teams.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to engage senior leaders during high-pressure situations.
Ability to assess operational risk, prioritise competing demands and make clear, timely decisions.
Experience producing service metrics, risk reporting, control evidence and management information.
Strong organisational skills, with a disciplined approach to action tracking and governance.
Ability to work primarily within regional operating hours, with occasional flexibility for significant global incidents or governance activities.
Desirable Qualifications
ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
Experience with recognized ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent.
Experience in financial services, banking or another highly regulated industry.
Knowledge of operational resilience, technology risk, audit and regulatory control frameworks.
Experience leading post-incident reviews and service improvement programmes.
Familiarity with Agile, DevOps or technology delivery models.
Key competencies
Incident leadership: Calm, decisive and structured under pressure.
Risk-based judgement: Able to balance delivery needs with control, resilience and compliance obligations.
Collaboration: Builds effective relationships across teams, regions and organisational boundaries.
Communication: Provides clear, audience-appropriate updates and escalations.
Accountability: Owns outcomes, follows through on actions and makes responsibilities explicit.
Continuous improvement: Uses data, trends and lessons learned to improve services and controls.
Influence: Gains commitment without relying solely on formal authority.
Success measures
Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through
Effective and timely management of regional major and high-priority incidents.
Quality and consistency of global incident handovers and stakeholder communications.
Improved incident resolution, recurrence and post-incident action performance.
Strong compliance with change assurance and ITSM governance requirements.
Timely closure of control actions, audit findings and process exceptions.
Improved service stability, operational resilience and stakeholder satisfaction.
Consistent adoption of ITSM standards across the department.

Corporate and Institutional Banking
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Impact on the Business/Function:
Support the execution of the Outbound strategy, including strategy paper, initiatives formulation, driving actions and track the deliverables.
Help drive the in-country execution of the Group's Outbound strategy to deliver revenues and achieve the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets.
Support customer account strategies and liaise with Regions/Branches assigning prospects and opportunities to HBCN Coverage Banker/Global Network Banking (GNB) RMs.
Develop metrics and reporting mechanisms that monitor execution of the Outbound strategy.
Interpret and communicate any global GNB and regulatory developments and ensure timely training and familiarization for frontline teams is delivered.
Support the execution of tactical projects to ensure that market firsts are attained for key products and market trends.
Work on strategy papers and presentations to raise Outbound and international awareness/knowledge for front-line colleagues.
Customers / Stakeholders
Build working level relationships with trade bodies, business councils and commercial chambers. Support capturing ODI opportunities.
Participate in meetings with Outbound clients and prospects, to provide guidance, pitch for new business, resolve any issues, and facilitate smooth operations and services, thus building loyalty and client satisfaction.
Help establish the agenda for internal education (e.g. workshops and seminars) and external marketing (client forums and summits).
Deepen customer relationships through championing business co-operation with key stakeholders including Global Business, Global Products and Global Functions, to contribute to Outbound strategy.
Support with planning workshops, forums, seminars, roadshows and presentations.
Work with in-country stakeholders where required to remove any blockages for transactions and coordinate escalation to resolve matters in a timely and efficient manner.
Leadership & Teamwork
Work closely with Global Businesses, Global Products and Global Functions to support on preparing content, papers and presentations related to execution of a comprehensive strategy for the China Outbound proposition.
Build network with Group offices (including global CIB, GNB and CDMs) to enhance profile and cooperation with China.
Help with managing CDM proposition/governance and support periodical review on CDM structure to align with China CIB and GNB management. Coordinate feedback to GNB teams on CDM performance and provide support on people management matters.
Operational Effectiveness & Control
Continually assess operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructuring and the impact of new technology.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Essential
Proven and progressive business development, sales management, and credit experience or equivalent.
Adaptability and mobility. The role may require the jobholder to frequently travel throughout China and work abroad on short term assignments.
Extensive knowledge and proven sales success with the Bank's products and services, or equivalent
Good understanding and knowledge of GNB and experience with working with multinational corporates.
Experience working with senior stakeholders in a global environment.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills including organizational, analytical, negotiation, communication, teamwork and influencing skills.
Ability to set and manage own agenda, while ensuring alignment with stakeholder priorities.
Excellent spoken and written Mandarin and English.
Desired
University graduate degree in business related field, or equivalent experience.
Understanding of local operating markets and their corresponding span(s) of control within assigned region.
Experience of driving strategic change in a matrix environment.
Group Leadership Capabilities - the following capabilities have been identified as essential for this role:
Navigating - Anticipating future needs of stakeholders, reconciling opposing stakeholder needs, ensuring the vision is understood by all stakeholders and translating Group Strategy into immediate business/function.
Aspiring - Knowledge of standards in leading global organizations, driving performance against leading global standards, competing successfully and actively improving capability.
Driving - Enabling others to take the lead, courageously taking on stretching challenges, thriving under pressure, seeking opportunities to transform immediate business/function and set stretching goals.
Mobilizing - Inspiring relevant stakeholders, championing diversity and inclusion within immediate business/function, fully leveraging the matrix, maximizing employee engagement, creating a high-performance culture, optimizing the pace of delivery.
Sustaining - Championing respect and fairness in dealings with others, enhancing the brand of HSBC, and championing HSBC Values and Culture.

确保客户投诉的时效与管理；
